title: Le Vide (Reserved, Unused)
summary: The browser reserves gigabytes of storage for this page; the work uses zero, and measures the emptiness to scale.
mechanism: navigator.storage.estimate() reads the origin's live storage quota vs. usage; a to-scale bar renders the vast reserved space against a near-zero (honestly nothing-stored) fill.
references: Yves Klein, Le Vide (Galerie Iris Clert, 1958)
Robert Barry, During the exhibition the gallery will be closed (1969)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
